# THE RETAIN-REFUSAL ROWS A LEG DOES NOT ANSWER YET (test/conformance/harness/
# retainrefusal.go). One line per leg and case: `<leg> <case> owed: <cause>`.
# The set is exact: a ledgered case the leg answers correctly is RED until its
# line is removed, and a failing case with no line is RED.
goose retain_refusal_body owed: load_table_retain resets the store only on entry, so a body refused mid-read leaves its partial capture for the next save
lobster retain_refusal_body owed: save_retain writes the retained records each loaded record carries (rec.retained), so the store load_retain empties on a refusal never stops the earlier read's tails
lobster retain_refusal_frame owed: save_retain writes the retained records each loaded record carries (rec.retained), so the store load_retain empties on a refusal never stops the earlier read's tails
lobster retain_refusal_kind31 owed: save_retain writes the retained records each loaded record carries (rec.retained), so the store load_retain empties on a refusal never stops the earlier read's tails
lobster retain_refusal_short owed: save_retain writes the retained records each loaded record carries (rec.retained), so the store load_retain empties on a refusal never stops the earlier read's tails
lobster retain_refusal_empty owed: save_retain writes the retained records each loaded record carries (rec.retained), so the store load_retain empties on a refusal never stops the earlier read's tails
lobster retain_refusal_form_two owed: save_retain writes the retained records each loaded record carries (rec.retained), so the store load_retain empties on a refusal never stops the earlier read's tails
